title: Muryoyin da ke Kusa da Ruwa Mai Tsabta
intro: Ka yi tunanin al'umma da aka sanya wa suna ba don birni ko mai mulki ba, sai don ruwan da ke kewaye da ita wanda rayuwa ta taru. Ɓangare kaɗan ne kawai ke tunawa da wannan al'umma, waɗanda koyaushe ake lissafa su cikin waɗanda suka ƙi shiriya. Ka saurara yayin da suke magana daga ɓoye.
clues: Mu al'umma ce da aka ambata a cikin Alqur'ani, amma cikakken labarinmu ya kasance a ɓoye cikin sirri.
Ana ambatonmu koyaushe tare da waɗanda suka ƙaryata, kamar mutanen Ada da Samudawa.
Ana kiranmu da Sahabban Ar-Rass, Rijiyar da rayuwarmu ta haɗu da ita.
Mun ƙaryata manzon da aka aiko mana da shiriya bayyananna.
Muna cikin waɗanda suka ƙi dukkan manzannin da Allah ya aiko.
Mun fuskanci barazanar da aka cika a kan kowane mai musantawa a gabanmu, halaka saboda ƙin amincewarmu.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
